For each choice of positions $i<j<k$, the condition $\pi(j)<\pi(k)<\pi(i)$ says the three values appear in the relative order "largest, smallest, middle" (pattern 312). Among the $3!=6$ possible relative orders of three values, exactly one satisfies this, so exactly $\frac{10!}{6}$ permutations realize it for any fixed triple of positions.

There are $\binom{10}{3}=120$ position triples, so the total count is

$$120\cdot\frac{10!}{6}=120\cdot 604800=72{,}576{,}000.$$

ANSWER: 72576000
